name: WU Wien
notes: Server-rendered listing shows only ~8 upcoming events total (no pagination; site just doesn't list many public events). Each item's data-id is expanded into a per-event JSON detail via window.eventCardData.url template (https://www.wu.ac.at/?type=9901&tx_news_pi1[news]={id}), which supplies venue, category tags, description and the real detail/external URL; listing HTML alone only gives title, date range and a Vor Ort/Online hint. One detail id (35731) 500'd on fetch - handled by falling back to the listing page URL and leaving venue/category from the list hint only. price never appears in the feed so price_min/price_text stay null.
